AIfeed.oneLiner: A curated AI dashboard that turns launches, papers and community chatter into practical tools you can use.

tidy-tabs.oneLiner: A Chrome extension that turns tab overload into native tab groups, with audio protection and a one-click tab vault.

RecapReel.oneLiner: A Chrome extension that plays long YouTube videos as AI-picked highlight reels using your own Gemini key.

mac-sentinel.oneLiner: A zero-dependency macOS diagnostics CLI for storage pressure, swap and broken launch agents.

macos-downloads-organizer.oneLiner: A zero-dependency launchd job that keeps ~/Downloads sorted, without overwriting or moving in-progress files.

tv-lobotomy.oneLiner: A quiet Android TV home screen: one app list, a clock, nothing else.
